summary: Orrstown Financial Services Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing two events: (a) a full redemption of its $31M 4.5% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2030 on June 30, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. The notes were assumed from its July 2024 merger with Codorus Valley Bancorp. (b) A vendor cybersecurity incident exposing customer information, but the company's systems were not breached and no material impact is expected. The redemption is a routine debt management action; the cybersecurity disclosure is an operational update. Neither constitutes a classic special-situation event, and no strategic shift is announced.
